stage1.impression: A clean, competent architectural visualisation of a narrow bar, not a photograph. It is evenly lit and too bright for night, with flat plaster and ceiling, a salmon-pink light band that is nearly blown, copy-pasted bottles, cool white pendants, confetti-like terrazzo and a porch panel whose oak looks like a smeared, stretched texture. No EARF speaker is visible, so the frame's colour comes from the pink band and the maroon banquette. As it stands a magazine would read it as a generic hospitality render, not a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median at 22 to 50 (now 69), with real pools of light on the counter, the shelves and the banquette and dark between them, instead of the even wash now on the baffle and the porch
The lantern's band reads as amber light through thick cast fins with visible fin edges and gradation, not a near-clipped salmon strip (now median 224, clip 4.7 %, RGB 250/218/209)
The porch and baffle oak reads as real oiled oak at 1:1 (grain, ray fleck, board joints), not vertical smeared streaks
The back bar reads as a curated real collection: varied bottles, no visible duplicate model
The pendants read warm (2700 K) and dimmed, not neutral white globes
Terrazzo chips at a believable honed scale and muted palette, not a multicolour confetti
A clear hero and sign of life: the lantern's face as the destination with light falling off around it, and lived-in props along the counter
The speaker or the lantern's interior glow legible through the porch, so the frame's one saturated colour is EARF's (if the camera can reach it)

defects.what: Lantern band nearly blown and salmon-pink rather than amber; fins read as a flat corrugated sheet, no edge glow; a hard diagonal light streak from the ceiling fitting cuts across it at x≈560-600
Porch's oak panel reads as stretched vertical streaks or a curtain, evenly lit, no grain or board joints; the black frame reads like a doorway with no porch depth
Slotted baffle evenly washed top to bottom (profile 147 to 138, only dropping at the counter), no graze shading, reads as a wall cladding sample
Bottles are visibly the same few models repeated with identical labels; shelf LED lines are cold white and clip
Pendants read neutral white (RGB ≈223/225/226) against a 2800 K room; the lamp shades read as plastic
Terrazzo counter face has large multicolour chips (red, blue, green) and reads as speckled laminate or rubber flooring
Ceiling is flat dark with a smeared light patch and a ghostly track line, no structure or texture
Lime plaster wall is flat and uniform, no trowel variation
Right plaster wall reads as noisy rust-orange gradient, denoiser blotching
Banquette leather is flat maroon with plastic sheen, no seams, creases or wear; the oak capping reads as a wood-grain print
Four identical tables in a row with identical props; low-table sizing makes the room read like a showroom
Overall too bright and even for night: frame median 69, only 36 % of the frame below 40

changes.problem: The frame is too bright and even to read as night.

evidence.measured: lum_p50 69.1, below_40 36 %, baffle median 131, porch 122, floor 111

changes.expected: Frame median about 42, baffle about 85, the band coming off clip; shadows deepen between pools

changes.problem: The band is a near-blown salmon strip, not amber light through thick fins.

change.setting: the lantern's band emission (and its colour temperature)
change.to: 1.4, 2000 K amber, so the Smoke fins tint it

changes.expected: Band median about 150 to 180 with visible fin-to-fin modulation and saturated amber; no clipping

changes.problem: The baffle and porch are washed flat, with no graze and no falloff, so the lantern's face reads as wall cladding.

evidence.measured: y-profile 147,145,147,144,143,138 before the counter: about 6 % drop over 300 px

change.setting: the baffle's graze area and the route and fill areas
change.to: graze 0.5 W/m2 moved to a 50 mm slot at the foot of the baffle aiming up; route 0.12; fill 0.03

changes.expected: The slats rake from bright at the foot to dark under the band, showing the slot depth; the porch drops into shade

changes.problem: The pendants and shelf lines are cold white in a 2800 K room.

change.setting: the Hemispheres' emission colour and the shelf and back-bar lines
change.to: 2400 K and dimmed about 50 % (shade glows, not white); lines 3.0 at 2400 K

changes.problem: The porch's oak and the banquette capping read as stretched texture, not oiled oak.

evidence.measured: lum_range 94 with only vertical streaking, no grain or joints at 1:1

change.to: real quartersawn oak scan at true scale (boards 120 to 150 mm with visible joints, ray fleck), oiled, roughness 0.45 with variation, slightly darker tone

changes.expected: The porch reads as joinery at 1:1, and its tone drops to a median of about 70 after c1

changes.problem: The terrazzo counter face reads as multicolour confetti laminate.

evidence.measured: large saturated red, blue and green chips visible at 1:1; lum_range 124

changes.problem: The back bar and tables show duplicated models and props, which says render.

changes.problem: The counter and banquette lack pools, and the banquette's leather reads flat and plastic.

change.setting: the counter spots and the banquette spots, and the leather finish

change.to: counter 5 x 18 W at 18 deg (tight pools on the quartzite); banquette 4 x 12 W at 18 deg; leather with a bump map, seams and roughness 0.55

out_of_scope.request: Get an EARF speaker (the Tropos pair in Ember) into the frame as the hero and its one saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The products are fixed inside the lantern and the camera from the shop table cannot see them; it needs a camera or brief decision (for example, a view through the open porch), which the owner should make

out_of_scope.request: Give the porch a visible depth and threshold so it reads as a sound lock rather than a framed panel
out_of_scope.why: It is the architecture as drawn, which is fixed

out_of_scope.request: Thicker fins with polished glowing edges on the band
out_of_scope.why: The band's place and fins are fixed; only their light may change

out_of_scope.request: Give the ceiling some structure (beams, joists)
out_of_scope.why: The ceiling is part of the fixed architecture; only its light and finish within kind may change
